svg.title: From placement words to labelled atoms
svg.desc: The 24 by 4 grid is split into six sectors. The top panel prints the matching index m in every atom. The lower panel selects the 16 atoms of piece i=0,j=2, and prints the quantum colour l together with the actual coefficient sign in each occupied atom.

g.text: Read sectors left to right, starting at the bottom row. Use m to select a Table I record.
Select i = 0 and j = 2: keep exactly those atoms whose matching satisfies τ(0) = 2.
Each printed entry is ±l: the sign comes from Tᵍ, and l = σ(0).
Each atom has area fraction 1/96. Add all fragments with the same (i,j,k,l) before taking a square root.
